snippet.title: NetherWorld | Official Launch Trailer [EN]
snippet.description:
NetherWorld is OUT NOW on Steam and Nintendo Switch!!
After 9 years in the making (7 since the Kickstarter!) and a 3-to-6 dev team, the day has come. Hope you enjoy it!
- - - - - - - - - -
TIME TO PLAY!
◈ Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420/NetherWorld/

◈ Nintendo Switch:
https://www.nintendo.com/es-es/Juegos/Juegos-de-Nintendo-Switch/NetherWorld-2846675.html

◈ Physical edition order:
https://linktr.ee/netherworldgame
- - - - - - - - - -
...NetherWhat?
NetherWorld is an action-adventure narrative experience that combines story, minigames and bosses to tell the life of Medoo: a jinxed jellyfish handling a marital crisis with alcohol, drugs, sex, blows and lots of odd characters.

◈ Story:
Get along with cokehead mages, entrepreneur prostitutes, mobsters, sociopath kids, old perverts and more to fix the pieces of your broken life, or at least to try it.

◈ Minigames:
Get money and items taking part in drinking competitions, having sex, shooting stuff or controlling a tick called Joe through filthy underground rogue-likish dungeons.

◈ Boss Fights:
Time to kick some asses! Fight (or survive at least) savage bosses during your crazy adventure using all kind of guns… or unarmed!
- - - - - - - - - -
FOLLOW US!
◈ Twitter (X): https://x.com/NetherWorldGame
◈ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/netherworldgame
- - - - - - - - - -
CREDITS:
◈ Idea, script & edition: Hungry Pixel
◈ 2D animation: Alkimia Animation Studio
◈ Production: Selecta Play
